images.title: A new value above the mean pulls it up
images.purpose: Before and after: adding 17 to the data 5, 5, 10, 24 moves the mean from 11 up to 12.2.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two identical number lines stacked one above the other with the same scale, labelled before and after.
images.exact_structure: Two horizontal number lines, one above the other, aligned on the same scale from 0 to 25 with unlabelled tick marks at every whole number; only the bottom line shows the numerals 5, 10, 17 and 24 under its ticks. Top line, labelled before at its left: 4 teal (#0072B2) dots, two stacked above 5, one above 10, one above 24, and a filled reddish purple (#CC79A7) triangle under the line at 11 with the label mean 11. Bottom line, labelled after at its left: the same 4 teal dots in the same places plus 1 amber (#E69F00) dot above 17, 5 dots in all, and the reddish purple triangle under the line at 12.2 with the label mean 12.2. A thin grey (#6B7280) dotted vertical guide runs from the top triangle down to 11 on the bottom line so the shift to the right is visible.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A new value bigger than the mean pulls the mean up.
images.description: Before and after: adding 17 to the data 5, 5, 10, 24 moves the mean from 11 up to 12.2.
images.context: Data 5, 5, 10, 24 with mean 11; new value 17; new mean 61 divided by 5 is 12.2.

image_decisions.why: A before and after dot plot shows the balance point moving when one value is added.
